# network.get_timezone_from_location { #cflowdist.network.get_timezone_from_location }

```python
network.get_timezone_from_location(location)
```

Get the timezone of a given Location object.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type     | Description                                            | Default    |
|----------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| location | Location | The location object containing latitude and longitude. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                   |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | str    | The timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York'). |
